summary: Probably John's 4th-great-grand-aunt by marriage; the widow 'Hulda Pringle' of the 1850 census.
bio:
Huldah Ives was born in New York about 1804. In the 1850 Plymouth Twp census (14 Sep 1850, dwelling 942/family 962, two doors from James Pringle's household): Hulda Pringle 46, F, $600, b. New York; Orange Pringle 23, teamster, PA; Ransom 21; 'Caturah' 17; Jane 14; Lucinda 10; Sarah 6; Lucy Ives 87, F (marked insane - probably her mother); Philip Minchart 26, carpenter. Her daughter Hannah J. married engineer George Bisher on 1 Jan 1856. Her will: Plymouth Boro., 1887, vol. J p.499. Joshua Lamoreaux (Martha's brother) married a Martha Ives, possibly her kin (speculative).

FamilySearch tree LH7R-KFK gives Hulda's parents as Josiah Ives Jr. (1770-1849, d. Michigan) and Lucy Williams (1768-1850), married in Plymouth on 26 Mar 1791. That fits the 'Lucy Ives, 87' in her 1850 household. The tree lists her siblings as Orin Almond, Martha, Lucinda, Henry B., Joseph, Josiah, Richard J. and Almon Church Ives. It also says she married Samuel D. Pringle (H0150) in 1824, that he died on 25 Mar 1847, and that she died in Plymouth Twp. on 29 Dec 1886 and was buried in Shawnee Cemetery on 3 Jan 1887. Her will was proved in 1887. Children in the tree: Mary Ann (b. Jan 1826, d. 1907), Orange (H0153), George Ransom (H0152), Elmira (b. 1831), Keturah (H0154), Hannah Jane (1836-1895), Lucinda (1841-1903) and Sarah (b. 1 Aug 1843, d. 1917) ([R4-S1]). The Philip Minchart, 26, a carpenter living in her house in 1850, is almost certainly the Philip Manhart (1823-1910) whom her daughter Keturah married as her second husband in 1883.
sources: 1850 US census, Plymouth Twp, Luzerne Co., PA, enumerated 14 Sep 1850 by A. Atherton, Ass't Marshal, page 140/141 (stamp 71), NARA M432; dwelling 942 / family 962 (Hulda Pringle household); FamilySearch record attached to tree person Andrew Pringle 1836-1900, FamilySearch ID KG4S-XMF (screenshot IMG_7813)

openQuestions: Josiah Ives Jr. and Lucy Williams as parents: tree only. Lucy Ives, 87, in her 1850 household supports the mother.
Joshua Lamoreaux married a Martha Ives; FS lists a sister Martha Ives b. 1798, which supports the Ives-Lamoreaux link (Martha Lamoreaux was Samuel Sr.'s wife).
